messages:
elaine: Hey team — planning messaging for the homepage + launch posts + webinar. Need a tight hero that unifies Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, and Private deployment for the launch week. Also must map inbound routing (blog, social, webinar signups) to the right landing pages and follow-up flows. Can we do quick hero variants + CTA routing options here? @mike @jen :wave:

mike: Sending 3 one-line hero variants in a sec. Want the tone more engineer-first or product-first? Leaning engineer-first for late-stage signups.

jen: Engineer-first works for benchmarks and webinars. For top-of-funnel social posts I'd soften to outcome-focused. We should have 2 hero lengths: short (8–10 words) + subhead (one sentence).

mike: Variant A (engineer-first): "Predictable LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments."

mike: Variant B (outcome-first): "Ship reliable, cost-effective LLM features — without ops overhead."

mike: Variant C (concise): "LLM inference that scales — hosted, dedicated, private."

sam: Love B for marketing pages. For product pages use A as a toggle. Also propose CTAs: "Try Hosted", "Reserve Capacity", "Request Private" — clear routing.

elaine: Good. Now inbound routing table — sketch below. Feedback pls. (short codeblock)

narrative-bot: 
```
/ -> hero (variant B) CTA: /signup?flow=hosted
/blog-posts -> article pages CTA: /resources
/webinar -> webinar-landing CTA: /webinar?utm=launch
/webinar/thank-you -> followup: email drip + invite to benchmarks webinar
/social/linkedin -> /blog or /webinar depending on post
/enterprise -> page: /dedicated (sales form)
``` 

jen: Suggest adding query params to track source and content: utm_source=linkedin|blog|email and utm_content=heroA|heroB

sam: For webinar follow-up flow: 1) immediate thank-you page with recording, 2) 24h email with short benchmark highlights + link to dedicated page, 3) SDR outreach for lead score > X.

ops-bot: Reminder — any new CTA that captures leads must create a ticket for CRM mapping. Slack thread: #sales-inbox + webhooks.

elaine: Next steps — mike finalize hero copy + short subheads, jen finalize tracking params, sam + ops to confirm webinar drip and CRM hooking. I'll assemble a one-pager for launch posts and webinar emails by EOD tomorrow. Thanks :sparkles:
